en: Black‑and‑white view over a formal town square or small park with young trees and paths in the foreground. Across the square stands a grand late‑19th‑century building with ornate stone façade, mansard and hipped roofs, likely a municipal or institutional building. To the right is a freestanding villa with a steep, hipped roof and arched gable dormer. Surrounding blocks consist of multi‑storey brick townhouses and apartment buildings. The scene appears European, photographed in winter or early spring, with bare trees and clear sky. No visible caption or border text appears on the image itself.
